decision.header_changes: Contract comments only; unchanged virtual signatures and exception specifications.
decision.zero_bytes: Forward unchanged into canonical malloc/_callnewh policy; no zero normalization or skip.
decision.foreign_domains: Pair internal allocation with reached BF6989; pair outer allocation with reached CPU BF65AC. Current virtual overrides remain in control.

callable_table_obligations: Actual readable current primary table with genuine Win32 __thiscall slot0(void*,uint32_t)->void*.
Table/code lifetime and actual grid-to-retained-NativeGameGridContext ownership; CPU service vptr and numeric00CFD484 do not satisfy this.
Explicit scalar adapter forwards receiver and flags to real context-bound helper; direct three-argument helper pointer has the wrong call shape.
Evidence-backed installation and destruction-state schedule accounts for constructor/destructor numeric stamps, interrupted cleanup and flag-zero destruction.
No receiver read after flag-one deletion; context/table/services and callback state survive until retirement finishes; no fabricated table, registry, publication or activation.

accepted_correction.preserve: BF6989 std::free, virtual signatures/overrides, sizes, six calls, current field reads, late zeroing, flags-bit0, partial failure state and all tables/publications.
accepted_correction.zero_size: Forward unchanged; canonical malloc/_callnewh retry/throw policy. No global-operator-new/Native-CRT equivalence claim.
accepted_correction.foreign_domains: Internal overrides must pair with reached BF6989; outer overrides must pair with reached CPU BF65AC. Both pairs independently valid; no interchange assumption.
